title: PatchConi agent report, protocol v1
description: One report sent by the agent to POST /api/v1/agent/reports. The API and the agent's tests validate against this file. Every object rejects unknown properties: servers are upgraded before agents, and a 1.x version only adds optional properties. Field meanings and sources: docs/product/protocol.md.
$comment: No remote $ref: every reference points into this file, so validation works offline. Patterns use only syntax that ECMA-262 and RE2 read the same way.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. The API reads it before validating, so that a newer version gets its own error instead of a list of unknown properties.

report_id.description: Random UUID chosen by the agent for this report. Retries send the same value; the server stores a report once per host and report_id.

agent_instance_id.description: Random UUID created when the agent's state directory is created. A reinstall, or a lost state directory, creates a new one.

sequence.description: Counter kept in the agent's state directory: 1 for the first report of an instance, one more for each later report. With agent_instance_id it orders reports without trusting the host clock.

machine_fingerprint.description: Application-specific ID derived from /etc/machine-id (as systemd-id128 machine-id --app-specific prints it), so that the raw machine ID never leaves the host. Null when the host has no readable machine ID.

collected_at.description: When the agent started collecting, by the host clock. Shown, never used for ordering or for policy clocks.

id_like.description: ID_LIKE split on spaces; empty when the file has none.

arch.description: Machine hardware name, as uname -m prints it.

running.description: Kernel release, as uname -r prints it.

newest_installed.description: Release of the newest installed kernel package, in the form uname -r prints, so that it compares with running. Null when no kernel package is installed, as in containers.

reboot_required.description: Whether the host says a reboot is required. Null when the agent cannot tell: dnf needs-restarting is not installed, or on apt no installed package maintains /var/run/reboot-required.

last_boot_at.description: Last boot, by the host clock.

metadata_age_seconds.description: Age of the package metadata the agent read, in seconds. Null when the agent cannot measure it; such a report is never trusted.

esm_enabled.description: Ubuntu only: whether the Expanded Security Maintenance repositories are enabled. Required when os.id is ubuntu, absent otherwise.

packages.description: What the package manager reported, or why the agent could not read it.

uuid.description: Lowercase UUID in the canonical form.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date and time in UTC, with a Z suffix.

token.description: Printable ASCII without spaces: package names, versions, kernel releases.

short_text.description: Free text from the host. Untrusted: the web escapes it.

package_arch.description: Package architecture: amd64, all (dpkg); x86_64, noarch (rpm).

held.description: Held packages as the package manager lists them: apt-mark showhold names, dnf versionlock patterns. For display.

packages_error.description: The agent could not read the package manager's output (AC-8.7). The rest of the report is still valid.

message.description: What went wrong, written by the agent. Untrusted: the web escapes it.

command.description: The command that failed, without its environment.

exit_code.description: Its exit code; null when it did not exit (killed or timed out).

update.description: One package with a newer version available, and the version the package manager would install. The server identifies it by name and arch: one entry per pair, which the API checks, since a schema cannot.

repository.description: Where the candidate comes from, as the package manager prints it: apt suites (comma separated), the dnf repository ID.

advisories.description: Advisories fixed by the update. apt has none: an empty list.

issued_on.description: Advisory date from the repository metadata; null when it has none. In v1 it is the date dnf updateinfo prints (Updated), which can be later than the issue date.
